# Address waits

Waiting on a word and waking its waiters through [`__ulock_wait`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ulock-wait) and [`__ulock_wake`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ulock-wake).

<h2 id="ul-compare-and-wait"><code>UL_COMPARE_AND_WAIT</code></h2>

```rux
pub const UL_COMPARE_AND_WAIT: uint32 = 1;
```

`UL_COMPARE_AND_WAIT`: wait on a 32-bit word that holds the expected value.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Ulock.rux#L11)

<h2 id="ulf-wake-all"><code>ULF_WAKE_ALL</code></h2>

```rux
pub const ULF_WAKE_ALL: uint32 = 0x100;
```

`ULF_WAKE_ALL`: wake every thread waiting on the word rather than one.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Ulock.rux#L16)

<h2 id="ulf-no-errno"><code>ULF_NO_ERRNO</code></h2>

```rux
pub const ULF_NO_ERRNO: uint32 = 0x01000000;
```

`ULF_NO_ERRNO`: report failure as a negative error number rather than through errno.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Ulock.rux#L21)

<h2 id="ulock-wait"><code>__ulock_wait</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func __ulock_wait(
    operation: uint32,
    address: *opaque,
    value: uint64,
    timeout: uint32
) -> int32
```

Sleeps while `*address` equals `value`, until a wake, a signal or the timeout.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Ulock.rux#L32)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type      | Description                                                                                                                            |
| ----------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `operation` | `uint32`  | [`UL_COMPARE_AND_WAIT`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ul-compare-and-wait), combined with [`ULF_NO_ERRNO`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ulf-no-errno) |
| `address`   | `*opaque` | the word to wait on, four-byte aligned                                                                                                 |
| `value`     | `uint64`  | the value the caller last saw there                                                                                                    |
| `timeout`   | `uint32`  | microseconds to wait at most, or zero to wait without a limit                                                                          |

**Returns**: the number of waiters left, or a failure: [`EINTR`](/docs/api/macos/errors#eintr), [`ETIMEDOUT`](/docs/api/macos/errors#etimedout), or [`EFAULT`](/docs/api/macos/errors#efault) when the word moved

<h2 id="ulock-wake"><code>__ulock_wake</code></h2>

```rux
pub extern func __ulock_wake(
    operation: uint32,
    address: *opaque,
    wakeValue: uint64
) -> int32
```

Wakes a thread, or all of them with [`ULF_WAKE_ALL`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ulf-wake-all), sleeping on `address`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/macOS/Src/Ulock.rux#L40)

**Parameters**

| Name        | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `operation` | `uint32`  | [`UL_COMPARE_AND_WAIT`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ul-compare-and-wait), combined with [`ULF_WAKE_ALL`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ulf-wake-all) and [`ULF_NO_ERRNO`](/docs/api/macos/ulock#ulf-no-errno) |
| `address`   | `*opaque` | the word they wait on                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `wakeValue` | `uint64`  | zero                                                                                                                                                                                            |

**Returns**: zero, or a failure: [`ENOENT`](/docs/api/macos/errors#enoent) when nothing was waiting
